cards.card_text: Now the LORD puts on righteousness like a breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on His head.
cards.verse_text: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on His head; He put on garments of vengeance and wrapped Himself in a cloak of zeal.
cards.snippet: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on His head; He put on garments…

cards.card_text: STAND firm, Paul says, with the belt of truth buckled around the waist and the breastplate of righteousness on.
cards.verse_text: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,
cards.snippet: …then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,

cards.card_text: Since they belong to the day, Paul tells them to be sober and suit up with a breastplate and a helmet.
cards.verse_text: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
cards.snippet: …we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.

cards.card_text: Paul tells the believers to put on a breastplate.
cards.verse_text: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
cards.snippet: …we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.

cards.card_text: The locusts in John's vision have breastplates like breastplates of iron, and their wings sound like the roar of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
cards.verse_text: They also had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the roar of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
cards.snippet: They also had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like…

cards.card_text: The riders in John's vision have breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire and sulfur.
cards.verse_text: Now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur.
cards.snippet: …horses and riders in my vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur.
